rita: Proposal: add an "auto-unpin" flow for runtime pins that meet clear regression signals. Keeps ops from doing noisy manual rollbacks.

jamie: High level ok. What are the regression signals?

rita: minimal set:
- p95 latency uplift >=20% sustained 20m
- 5xx rate +5% absolute for 15m
- memory OOMs increase >=2 events in 10m
Plus traffic gating: require >=600 tokens/s in at least one canary region.

sre-erin: Also require KV-cache prefill flag; otherwise transient cold-cache spikes will trigger.

rita: Agreed — add prefill check. Action path: post incident draft, soft-unpin staged (10% -> 40% -> 100%) with 10m observation at each step. If degradation persists, call `/deploy revert-pin <id>` and mute auto-unpin for 30m.

deploybot: [info] runtime pin applied: v3.2.4 -> llama3x-na (actor: @rita) tag: stability-watch at 2024-08-02T14:02:00Z.

jamie: Can we append a small QA generation check at each stage? 30 prompts, fail if >=7% semantic diffs.

rita: yes — add QA gate and auto-append reason to release note. Also set pin TTL=36h; require engineering signoff to extend.

sre-erin: I'll implement the KV prefill hook and notify ops for cost approval if fallback used.

deploybot: [scheduled] auto-unpin hooks attached. soft-unpin timeline scheduled at 1723457400. To cancel: `/deploy cancel 1723457400`.

rita: Decision: enable auto-unpin for this runtime pin following the above criteria. We'll observe and iterate.
